entity.summary: Perpetual futures decentralized exchange built on the Dango Layer 1 network. Dango announced an orderly project wind-down on 24 July 2026, with trading scheduled to halt on 29 July and the underlying chain scheduled to stop on 13 August.
entity.notes: Dango remains in a phased wind-down rather than a completed shutdown. HEI therefore uses limited, leaves death_reason and death_date null, and records only the shutdown announcement. The scheduled 29 July trading halt and 13 August chain stop require later verification before a shutdown_effective event or dead classification is added.

events.title: Dango perpetuals exchange went live
events.description: Dango announced that its perpetual futures exchange was live on the Dango Layer 1 network.
events.notes: The event records the public perps launch rather than an earlier testnet or chain-development milestone.

events.title: Dango announced project wind-down
events.description: Dango announced that trading would halt on 29 July 2026 at 12:00 UTC and that the Dango Layer 1 network would stop on 13 August 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
events.notes: Remaining positions are scheduled to close at oracle prices, DLP vault deposits are scheduled to unlock, and funds are scheduled to return as USDC. This is an announcement event; future completion is not pre-recorded.

evidence.title: Dango perps are live
evidence.notes: First-party launch announcement for the public perpetual futures exchange.

evidence.title: Dango project wind-down announcement
evidence.notes: First-party notice gives the trading-halt, position-closure, DLP unlock, USDC return, chain-stop, and residual-deposit refund schedule.

evidence.title: Perp DEX Dango to Wind Down, Will Halt Trading July 29
evidence.notes: Independent reporting corroborates the phased shutdown schedule and identifies Dango as a perpetuals DEX on its own Layer 1.
